daas-irab:1-3.t: ﴿اقْتَرَبَ﴾ a past verb. ﴿لِلنَّاسِ﴾ the two (preposition and its genitive noun) are attached to (mutaʿalliq) اقترب. ﴿حِسابُهُمْ﴾ fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and هم is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿فِي غَفْلَةٍ﴾ the two are attached to معرضون. ﴿مُعْرِضُونَ﴾ khabar (predicate); the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿يَأْتِيهِمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿ذِكْرٍ﴾ a noun genitive in form, nominative in position, as fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to a naʿt (adjective) of ذكر. ﴿مُحْدَثٍ﴾ a second naʿt. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿اسْتَمَعُوهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿وَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial and هم is mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَلْعَبُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of هم, and the clause of mubtadaʾ and khabar is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿لاهِيَةً﴾ a ḥāl from the wāw in يلعبون. ﴿قُلُوبُهُمْ﴾ fāʿil of لاهية. ﴿وَأَسَرُّوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and أسروا is a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿النَّجْوَى﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, badal (substitute) from the fāʿil of أسروا; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿ظَلَمُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿هَلْ﴾ an interrogative noun. [Translator's note: the source calls هل a noun (اسم); it is ordinarily classed as an interrogative particle.] ﴿هذا﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction. ﴿بَشَرٌ﴾ khabar. ﴿مِثْلُكُمْ﴾ a naʿt, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَفَتَأْتُونَ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation and the fāʾ is a conjunction; an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿السِّحْرَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَأَنْتُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ, and the wāw is circumstantial. ﴿تُبْصِرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is a ḥāl.

daas-irab:4-5.t: ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿رَبِّي﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject), and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech). ﴿يَعْلَمُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْقَوْلَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فِي السَّماءِ﴾ the two (preposition and its genitive noun) are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from القول. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and [it is] maʿṭūf (conjoined) to السماء. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; هو is mubtadaʾ. ﴿السَّمِيعُ﴾ khabar. ﴿الْعَلِيمُ﴾ a second khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿أَضْغاثُ﴾ khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿أَحْلامٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression. ﴿افْتَراهُ﴾ a past verb and its object, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun. ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression. ﴿هُوَ﴾ a pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿شاعِرٌ﴾ khabar. ﴿فَلْيَأْتِنا﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition), the lām is for command, and يأتنا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by deletion of the weak letter; نا is its object and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿بِآيَةٍ﴾ the two are attached to يأتنا; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿كَما﴾ ما is relative; [the kāf and ما] are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of آية. ﴿أُرْسِلَ الْأَوَّلُونَ﴾ a passive past verb and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is a ṣila (relative clause) with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:6-9.t: ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿آمَنَتْ﴾ a past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine; the clause is resumptive. ﴿قَبْلَهُمْ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿قَرْيَةٍ﴾ a noun genitive in form, nominative in position, as fāʿil (agent). ﴿أَهْلَكْناها﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is a naʿt (adjective). ﴿أَفَهُمْ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation and the fāʾ is a conjunction. ﴿هم﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and ما is negating. ﴿أَرْسَلْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿قَبْلَكَ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿رِجالًا﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿نُوحِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ owing to heaviness; the fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿إِلَيْهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) نوحي; the clause نوحي إليهم is in the position of the accusative as a naʿt of رجالا. ﴿فَسْئَلُوا﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition), and اسألوا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil. ﴿أَهْلَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الذِّكْرِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِنْ﴾ conditional. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the tāʾ is its noun. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿تَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of كنتم, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and ما is negating. ﴿جَعَلْناهُمْ﴾ a past verb, fāʿil and first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿جَسَداً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿يَأْكُلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿الطَّعامَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is in the position of the accusative as a naʿt of جسد. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; ما is negating. ﴿كانُوا﴾ an incomplete past verb, and the wāw is its noun. ﴿خالِدِينَ﴾ its khabar, accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to يأكلون. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿صَدَقْناهُمُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its first object. ﴿الْوَعْدَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَأَنْجَيْناهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and [من is] a relative noun conjoined to هم. ﴿نَشاءُ﴾ the clause نشاء is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَأَهْلَكْنَا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿الْمُسْرِفِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:10-12.t: ﴿لَقَدْ﴾ the lām is the response to an omitted oath. ﴿قد﴾ a particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿أَنْزَلْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿إِلَيْكُمْ﴾ the two (preposition and its genitive noun) are attached to (mutaʿalliq) أنزلنا. ﴿كِتاباً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فِيهِ﴾ the two are attached to a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿ذِكْرُكُمْ﴾ postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of كتابا. ﴿أَفَلا﴾ the hamza is for disapproving interrogation, the fāʾ is a conjunction, and لا is negating. ﴿تَعْقِلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿وَكَمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction or resumptive. ﴿كَمْ﴾ declarative (khabariyya), in the position of the accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi of قصمنا. ﴿قَصَمْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنْ قَرْيَةٍ﴾ a genitive noun, the tamyīz (specification) of كم. ﴿كانَتْ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿ظالِمَةً﴾ khabar of كان; the clause is a naʿt of قرية. ﴿وَأَنْشَأْنا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بَعْدَها﴾ an adverb attached to أنشأنا. ﴿قَوْماً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿آخَرِينَ﴾ a naʿt. ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and لما is the temporal (ḥīniyya) one, an adverb of time. ﴿أَحَسُّوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بَأْسَنا﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِذا﴾ the [idhā] of surprise (fujāʾiyya). ﴿هُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿مِنْها﴾ the two are attached to يركضون. ﴿يَرْكُضُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of هم.

daas-irab:13-16.t: ﴿لا﴾ prohibitive. ﴿تَرْكُضُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech) of an omitted verb. ﴿وَارْجِعُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿ارْجِعُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿إِلى ما﴾ the two (preposition and its genitive noun) are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ارجعوا. ﴿أُتْرِفْتُمْ﴾ a passive past verb and nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿فِيهِ﴾ the two are attached to أترفتم. ﴿وَمَساكِنِكُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and مساكنكم is a conjoined noun, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ﴾ a particle resembling the verb, and the kāf is its noun. ﴿تُسْئَلُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of لعل. ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا وَيْلَنا﴾ يا is a vocative particle. ﴿وَيْلَنا﴾ the one addressed (munādā), in a genitive construct (muḍāf); the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿إِنَّا﴾ a particle resembling the verb, and نا is its noun. ﴿كُنَّا ظالِمِينَ﴾ كان, its noun and its khabar; the clause is the khabar of إن. ﴿فَما زالَتْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿تِلْكَ﴾ a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as its noun. ﴿دَعْواهُمْ﴾ its khabar, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi and the mīm is for the plural; the clause is conjoined. ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit (ghāya) taking the genitive. ﴿جَعَلْناهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿حَصِيداً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿خامِدِينَ﴾ a naʿt (adjective) of حصيدا. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and ما is negating. ﴿خَلَقْنَا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿السَّماءَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَالْأَرْضَ﴾ conjoined to السماء. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and ما is a relative noun conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿بَيْنَهُما﴾ an adverb of place attached to an omitted ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿لاعِبِينَ﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural.

daas-irab:17-20.t: ﴿لَوْ﴾ conditional, not jussive-governing. ﴿أَرَدْنا﴾ a past verb and fāʿil (agent). ﴿أَنْ﴾ accusative-governing. ﴿نَتَّخِذَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being نحن. ﴿لَهْواً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the object of أردنا. ﴿لَاتَّخَذْناهُ﴾ the lām occurs in the apodosis of لو. ﴿اتخذناه﴾ a past verb, fāʿil and first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنْ لَدُنَّا﴾ the two (preposition and its genitive noun) are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَنْ﴾ negating, in the sense of ما. [Translator's note: the Quranic text reads ﴿إِنْ﴾ (in) here; the source writes أن.] ﴿كُنَّا﴾ كان and its noun. ﴿فاعِلِينَ﴾ its khabar (predicate). ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿نَقْذِفُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent. ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾ the two are attached to نقذف. ﴿عَلَى الْباطِلِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَيَدْمَغُهُ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction. ﴿يدمغه﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿فَإِذا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction. ﴿إذا﴾ the [idhā] of surprise (fujāʾiyya). ﴿هُوَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿زاهِقٌ﴾ khabar. ﴿وَلَكُمُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿لَكُمُ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted khabar. ﴿الْوَيْلُ﴾ postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِمَّا تَصِفُونَ﴾ من is a preposition. ﴿ما﴾ relative; the two are attached to the omitted khabar of ويل. ﴿تَصِفُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَلَهُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿لَهُ﴾ the two are attached to a fronted khabar. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative noun, postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ṣila. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative noun conjoined to من في السموات. ﴿عِنْدَهُ﴾ an adverb of place attached to an omitted ṣila, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿عَنْ عِبادَتِهِ﴾ the two are attached to يستكبرون, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; لا is negating. ﴿يَسْتَحْسِرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿يُسَبِّحُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿اللَّيْلَ﴾ an adverb of time attached to يسبحون. ﴿وَالنَّهارَ﴾ conjoined. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿يَفْتُرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is a ḥāl.

daas-irab:21-23.t: ﴿أَمِ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿اتَّخَذُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿آلِهَةً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مِنَ الْأَرْضِ﴾ the two (preposition and its genitive noun) are attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of آلهة. ﴿هُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يُنْشِرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause هم ينشرون is a second naʿt of آلهة. ﴿لَوْ﴾ conditional, not jussive-governing. ﴿كانَ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿فِيهِما﴾ the two are attached to a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿آلِهَةٌ﴾ its postponed noun. ﴿إِلَّا اللَّهُ﴾ in the sense of غير (other than), in the position of the nominative as a naʿt, with the Name of Majesty as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لَفَسَدَتا﴾ the lām occurs in the apodosis of لو; a past verb, the tāʾ is the tāʾ of the feminine and the alif is the fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿فَسُبْحانَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction. ﴿سبحان﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿رَبِّ﴾ badal (substitute) from الله. ﴿الْعَرْشِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَمَّا﴾ عن and the relative ما; the two are attached to سبحان. ﴿يَصِفُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is a ṣila (relative clause) with no grammatical position. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿يُسْئَلُ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿عَمَّا﴾ the two are attached to يسأل. ﴿يَفْعَلُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction or circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿هُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿يُسْئَلُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil; the clause يسألون is the khabar, and the clause of mubtadaʾ and khabar is conjoined or a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:24-27.t: ﴿أَمِ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿اتَّخَذُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿مِنْ دُونِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun in the position of the accusative as the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of اتخذوا. ﴿آلِهَةً﴾ first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿هاتُوا﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw of the group is the fāʿil. ﴿بُرْهانَكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) and the mīm is for the plural. ﴿هذا﴾ the hā is for calling attention (tanbīh), and ذا is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿ذِكْرُ﴾ khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنْ﴾ a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi. And ﴿مَعِيَ﴾ an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause), and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَذِكْرُ﴾ conjoined to the first ذكر. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قَبْلِي﴾ an adverb of time attached to the ṣila of the relative noun, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿أَكْثَرُهُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar. ﴿الْحَقَّ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَهُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is a particle of causation (taʿlīl), and هم is mubtadaʾ. ﴿مُعْرِضُونَ﴾ khabar. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive and ما is negating. ﴿أَرْسَلْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِكَ﴾ the two (preposition and its genitive noun) are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مِنْ رَسُولٍ﴾ من is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿رَسُولٍ﴾ genitive in form, accusative in position as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿نُوحِي﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil a latent pronoun. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ the two are attached to نوحي. ﴿أَنَّهُ﴾ a particle resembling the verb, and the hāʾ is its noun. ﴿لا إِلهَ﴾ لا is the lā of generic negation, and إله is its noun; the clause is the khabar of أنه. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction. ﴿أَنَا﴾ badal (substitute) from the position of لا and its noun. ﴿فَاعْبُدُونِ﴾ the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition). ﴿اعبدون﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya); its fāʿil [is the wāw], and its object is the deleted yāʾ; the clause has no grammatical position. ﴿وَقالُوا﴾ the wāw is resumptive. ﴿وَقالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿اتَّخَذَ الرَّحْمنُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿وَلَداً﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech). ﴿سُبْحانَهُ﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being سبح; the clause is parenthetical. ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression. ﴿عِبادٌ﴾ khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being هم. ﴿مُكْرَمُونَ﴾ a naʿt (adjective). ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿يَسْبِقُونَهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is a naʿt. ﴿بِالْقَوْلِ﴾ the two are attached to يسبقونه. ﴿وَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿هُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿بِأَمْرِهِ﴾ the two are attached to يعملون, and the clause يعملون is the khabar of هم; the clause ﴿هُمْ بِأَمْرِهِ يَعْمَلُونَ﴾ is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to what precedes.

daas-irab:28-29.t: ﴿يَعْلَمُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun; the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of what precedes. ﴿ما﴾ ما is relative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿بَيْنَ﴾ an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause). ﴿أَيْدِيهِمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَما خَلْفَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and ما is relative, conjoined to what precedes. ﴿خَلْفَهُمْ﴾ an adverb attached to the ṣila, and the mīm is the sign of the plural; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and لا is negating. ﴿يَشْفَعُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is a naʿt. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿لِمَنِ﴾ the lām is a preposition and من is a relative noun; the two are attached to يشفعون. ﴿ارْتَضى﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil latent; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿وَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿هُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مِنْ خَشْيَتِهِ﴾ the two (preposition and its genitive noun) are attached to مشفقون. ﴿مُشْفِقُونَ﴾ khabar (predicate) of هم; the clause is conjoined to what precedes. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَقُلْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), its fāʿil latent. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿إِنِّي إِلهٌ﴾ إن, its noun and its khabar; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech). ﴿مِنْ دُونِهِ﴾ the two are attached to the khabar. ﴿فَذلِكَ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis. ﴿ذلك﴾ mubtadaʾ; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿نَجْزِيهِ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the khabar of ذلك. ﴿جَهَنَّمَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾ the kāf is a preposition, and the demonstrative is in the position of the genitive; the two are attached to a naʿt of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿نَجْزِي﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil omitted. [Translator's note: the source says "omitted" (محذوف); elsewhere it describes such a fāʿil as latent (mustatir).] ﴿الظَّالِمِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of the mubtadaʾ من.

daas-irab:30-31.t: ﴿أَوَلَمْ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation and the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿لَمْ﴾ a particle of negation, jussive government and conversion [of the imperfect to past meaning]. ﴿يَرَ﴾ an imperfect verb. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ fāʿil (agent). ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿أَنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ its noun. ﴿وَالْأَرْضَ﴾ conjoined; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) fills the place of the two objects of ير. ﴿كانَتا﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the alif is its noun. ﴿رَتْقاً﴾ its khabar (predicate); the clause كانتا رتقا is the khabar of أن. ﴿فَفَتَقْناهُما﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction. ﴿فتقناهما﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to كانتا. ﴿وَجَعَلْنا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنَ الْماءِ﴾ the two (preposition and its genitive noun) are attached to (mutaʿalliq) جعلنا. ﴿كُلَّ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿حَيٍّ﴾ a naʿt (adjective). ﴿أَفَلا﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, the fāʾ is a conjunction and لا is negating. ﴿يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿وَجَعَلْنا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿جَعَلْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿رَواسِيَ﴾ first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَنْ﴾ an accusative-governing particle. ﴿تَمِيدَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن; أن and what follows it are, as an interpreted maṣdar, a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿بِهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to تميد. ﴿وَجَعَلْنا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فِيها﴾ the two are attached to جعلنا. ﴿فِجاجاً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿سُبُلًا﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لَعَلَّهُمْ﴾ لعل is a particle resembling the verb, and the hāʾ is its noun. ﴿يَهْتَدُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of لعل.

daas-irab:32-34.t: ﴿وَجَعَلْنَا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿السَّماءَ﴾ first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿سَقْفاً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مَحْفُوظاً﴾ mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). [Translator's note: so in the source; محفوظا is ordinarily parsed as a naʿt (adjective) of سقفا.] ﴿وَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) and هم is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿عَنْ آياتِها﴾ the two (preposition and its genitive noun) are attached to (mutaʿalliq) معرضون. ﴿مُعْرِضُونَ﴾ khabar (predicate) of هم; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿هُوَ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ khabar of هو. ﴿خَلَقَ﴾ the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿اللَّيْلَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَالنَّهارَ﴾ conjoined to الليل. ﴿وَالشَّمْسَ﴾ conjoined. ﴿وَالْقَمَرَ﴾ conjoined. ﴿كُلٌّ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِي فَلَكٍ﴾ the two are attached to يسبحون; the clause of mubtadaʾ and khabar is a ḥāl. ﴿يَسْبَحُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of كل. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿جَعَلْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لِبَشَرٍ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِكَ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted naʿt of بشر. ﴿الْخُلْدَ﴾ first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَفَإِنْ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, the fāʾ is a conjunction, and إن is a jussive-governing conditional particle. ﴿مِتَّ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَهُمُ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis. ﴿هم﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْخالِدُونَ﴾ khabar; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).

daas-irab:35-38.t: ﴿كُلُّ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿نَفْسٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿ذائِقَةُ﴾ khabar (predicate); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿الْمَوْتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَنَبْلُوكُمْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive. ﴿نَبْلُوكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), and the kāf is its object. ﴿بِالشَّرِّ﴾ the two (preposition and its genitive noun) are attached to (mutaʿalliq) نبلوكم. ﴿وَالْخَيْرِ﴾ conjoined to الشر; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فِتْنَةً﴾ mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿وَإِلَيْنا﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ترجعون. ﴿تُرْجَعُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَإِذا﴾ the wāw is resumptive. ﴿إِذا﴾ adverbial and conditional. ﴿رَآكَ﴾ a past verb and its object; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, fāʿil. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِنْ﴾ negating. ﴿يَتَّخِذُونَكَ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its first object. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿هُزُواً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿أَهذَا﴾ the hamza is for interrogation. ﴿هذَا﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ khabar. ﴿يَذْكُرُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent; the clause is a ṣila with no grammatical position. ﴿آلِهَتَكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿وَهُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿بِذِكْرِ﴾ the two are attached to كافرون. ﴿الرَّحْمنِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿هُمْ﴾ tawkīd (emphasis) of the first هم. ﴿كافِرُونَ﴾ their khabar; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿خُلِقَ﴾ a passive past verb. ﴿الْإِنْسانُ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِنْ عَجَلٍ﴾ the two are attached to خلق. ﴿سَأُرِيكُمْ﴾ the sīn is for the future; an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent, and its first object. ﴿آياتِي﴾ second mafʿūl bihi, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction and لا is prohibitive. ﴿تَسْتَعْجِلُونِ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by deletion of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil, the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the deleted yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿وَيَقُولُونَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مَتى﴾ an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as an adverb, attached to the fronted khabar; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech). ﴿هذَا﴾ postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْوَعْدُ﴾ badal (substitute) from هذا. ﴿إِنْ كُنْتُمْ﴾ إن is a jussive-governing conditional particle. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb and its noun. ﴿صادِقِينَ﴾ khabar of كان; the clause كنتم is initial with no grammatical position, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted.

daas-irab:39-40.t: ﴿لَوْ﴾ conditional, not jussive-governing. ﴿يَعْلَمُ﴾ an imperfect verb. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, fāʿil (agent). ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿حِينَ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿يَكُفُّونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is a ṣila. [Translator's note: so in the source; a clause after حين is ordinarily parsed as muḍāf ilayhi.] ﴿عَنْ وُجُوهِهِمُ﴾ the two (preposition and its genitive noun) are attached to (mutaʿalliq) يكفون, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿النَّارَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; لا is negating. ﴿عَنْ ظُهُورِهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to يكفون. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿هُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يُنْصَرُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression (iḍrāb) and conjunction. ﴿تَأْتِيهِمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir). ﴿بَغْتَةً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَتَبْهَتُهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; لا is negating. ﴿يَسْتَطِيعُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿رَدَّها﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿هُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿يُنْظَرُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is the khabar, and the clause of mubtadaʾ and khabar is conjoined.

daas-irab:41-43.t: ﴿وَلَقَدِ﴾ the wāw is resumptive. ﴿لَقَدِ﴾ the lām occurs in the response to an omitted oath. ﴿قد﴾ a particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿اسْتُهْزِئَ﴾ a passive past verb. ﴿بِرُسُلٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun standing in the place of the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِكَ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of رسل. ﴿فَحاقَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction. ﴿حاق﴾ a past verb. ﴿بِالَّذِينَ﴾ the bāʾ is a preposition. ﴿الذين﴾ a relative noun; the two are attached to حاق. ﴿سَخِرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ the two are attached to سخروا. ﴿ما﴾ ما is a relative noun, fāʿil. ﴿كانُوا﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the wāw is its noun. ﴿بِهِ﴾ the two are attached to يستهزئون. ﴿يَسْتَهْزِؤُنَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the accusative as the khabar (predicate) of كانوا. ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿مَنْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَكْلَؤُكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar, and the clause of mubtadaʾ and khabar is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech). ﴿بِاللَّيْلِ﴾ the two are attached to يكلؤكم. ﴿وَالنَّهارِ﴾ conjoined to الليل. ﴿مِنَ الرَّحْمنِ﴾ the two are attached to يكلؤهم [sic]. [Translator's note: the source writes يكلؤهم; the verb in the verse is يكلؤكم.] ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿هُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَنْ ذِكْرِ﴾ the two are attached to معرضون. ﴿رَبِّهِمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مُعْرِضُونَ﴾ khabar of هم. ﴿أَمْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ the two are attached to a fronted khabar. ﴿آلِهَةٌ﴾ postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿تَمْنَعُهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿مِنْ دُونِنا﴾ the two are attached to تمنعهم; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿يَسْتَطِيعُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿نَصْرَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنْفُسِهِمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is resumptive. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿هُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنَّا﴾ the two are attached to يصحبون; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يُصْحَبُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by retention of the nūn, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is the khabar.

daas-irab:44-46.t: ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿مَتَّعْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿هؤُلاءِ﴾ the hā is for calling attention (tanbīh); أولاء is a demonstrative in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَآباءَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿آباءَهُمْ﴾ conjoined to هؤلاء, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive. ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit (ghāya) taking the genitive. ﴿طالَ﴾ a past verb. ﴿عَلَيْهِمُ﴾ the two (preposition and its genitive noun) are attached to (mutaʿalliq) طال. ﴿الْعُمُرُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿أَفَلا﴾ the hamza is for interrogation and the fāʾ is a conjunction. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿يَرَوْنَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿أَنَّا﴾ أن is a particle resembling the verb and نا is its noun; its original form is أننا, and the two nūns were assimilated. ﴿نَأْتِي﴾ an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿الْأَرْضَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; أنّا and what follows it fill the place of the two objects of يرون. ﴿نَنْقُصُها﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, its fāʿil latent, its implied form being نحن. ﴿مِنْ أَطْرافِها﴾ the two are attached to ننقصها; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿أَفَهُمُ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation and the fāʾ is a conjunction. ﴿هم﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الْغالِبُونَ﴾ khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive. ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, its fāʿil latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّما﴾ the restraining [mā] and the restrained [inna] (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿أُنْذِرُكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, its fāʿil latent; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech). ﴿بِالْوَحْيِ﴾ the two are attached to أنذركم. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿يَسْمَعُ﴾ an imperfect verb. ﴿الصُّمُّ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿الدُّعاءَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿إِذا﴾ adverbial. ﴿ما﴾ redundant (zāʾida). ﴿يُنْذَرُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلَئِنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿لَئِنْ﴾ the lām paves the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam). ﴿إن﴾ a jussive-governing conditional particle. ﴿مَسَّتْهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its object; it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿نَفْحَةٌ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ عَذابِ﴾ the two are attached to a naʿt (adjective) of نفحة. ﴿رَبِّكَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَيَقُولُنَّ﴾ the lām occurs in the response to the oath. ﴿يقولن﴾ an imperfect verb; the wāw, which is the fāʿil, was deleted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters. ﴿يا وَيْلَنا﴾ يا is for the vocative or for calling attention. ﴿وَيْلَنا﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an implied (muqaddar) verb. ﴿إِنَّا﴾ إن and its noun; its original form is إننا. ﴿كُنَّا﴾ كان and its noun; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿ظالِمِينَ﴾ khabar of كنا; the clause is the khabar of إن.

daas-irab:47-49.t: ﴿وَنَضَعُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir). ﴿الْمَوازِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿الْقِسْطَ﴾ a naʿt (adjective). ﴿لِيَوْمِ﴾ the two (preposition and its genitive noun) are attached to (mutaʿalliq) نضع. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿تُظْلَمُ﴾ a passive imperfect verb. ﴿نَفْسٌ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿شَيْئاً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; إن is conditional. ﴿كانَ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿مِثْقالَ﴾ its khabar (predicate). ﴿حَبَّةٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْ خَرْدَلٍ﴾ the two are attached to a naʿt of حبة. ﴿أَتَيْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) with no grammatical position. ﴿بِها﴾ the two are attached to أتينا. ﴿وَكَفى﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; a past verb. ﴿بِنا﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition, and نا is in the position of the nominative as fāʿil. ﴿حاسِبِينَ﴾ tamyīz (specification). ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, the lām occurs in the response to an omitted oath, and قد is a particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿آتَيْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿مُوسى﴾ first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَهارُونَ﴾ conjoined to موسى. ﴿الْفُرْقانَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَضِياءً﴾ conjoined to الفرقان. ﴿وَذِكْراً﴾ conjoined. ﴿لِلْمُتَّقِينَ﴾ the two are attached to ذكرا. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a naʿt. ﴿يَخْشَوْنَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿رَبَّهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِالْغَيْبِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of يخشون. ﴿وَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿هُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مِنَ السَّاعَةِ﴾ the two are attached to مشفقون. ﴿مُشْفِقُونَ﴾ khabar of هم; the clause is a ḥāl.

daas-irab:50-53.t: ﴿وَهذا﴾ the wāw is resumptive. ﴿هذا﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿ذِكْرٌ﴾ khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive. ﴿مُبارَكٌ﴾ a naʿt (adjective). ﴿أَنْزَلْناهُ﴾ a past verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is a naʿt. ﴿أَفَأَنْتُمْ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation and the fāʾ is a conjunction. ﴿أنتم﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿لَهُ﴾ the two (preposition and its genitive noun) are attached to (mutaʿalliq) منكرون. ﴿مُنْكِرُونَ﴾ khabar of أنتم; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and the lām occurs in the response to the oath. ﴿قد﴾ a particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿آتَيْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿إِبْراهِيمَ﴾ first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿رُشْدَهُ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَكُنَّا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; كان and its noun. ﴿بِهِ﴾ the two are attached to عالمين. ﴿عالِمِينَ﴾ khabar of كنا; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb attached to an omitted verb, اذكر. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb, and its fāʿil is omitted; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). [Translator's note: the source says "omitted" (محذوف); the fāʿil is ordinarily called latent (mustatir).] ﴿لِأَبِيهِ﴾ the two are attached to قال. ﴿وَقَوْمِهِ﴾ conjoined to أبيه. ﴿ما﴾ an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿هذِهِ﴾ the hā is for calling attention (tanbīh). ﴿ذه﴾ khabar; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech). ﴿التَّماثِيلُ﴾ badal (substitute) from the demonstrative. ﴿الَّتِي﴾ a naʿt of التماثيل. ﴿أَنْتُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿لَها﴾ the two are attached to عاكفون. ﴿عاكِفُونَ﴾ khabar; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَجَدْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿آباءَنا﴾ first mafʿūl bihi, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَها﴾ the two are attached to عابدين. ﴿عابِدِينَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl.

daas-irab:54-57.t: ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir). ﴿لَقَدْ﴾ the lām occurs in the response to an omitted oath. ﴿قد﴾ a particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ كان and its noun. ﴿أَنْتُمْ﴾ tawkīd (emphasis). ﴿وَآباؤُكُمْ﴾ conjoined to the noun of كان. ﴿فِي ضَلالٍ﴾ the two (preposition and its genitive noun) are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿مُبِينٍ﴾ a naʿt (adjective); the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech). ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَجِئْتَنا﴾ the hamza is for interrogation. ﴿جِئْتَنا﴾ a past verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾ the two are attached to جئتنا; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿أَمْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿أَنْتَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مِنَ اللَّاعِبِينَ﴾ the two are attached to the khabar of أنت; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿رَبُّكُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿رَبُّ﴾ khabar. ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿الْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined to السموات; the clause is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. [Translator's note: so in the source; the nominal clause is presumably meant as the maqūl al-qawl of قال.] ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a naʿt of رب, in the position of the nominative. ﴿فَطَرَهُنَّ﴾ a past verb and its object, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَأَنَا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿أَنَا﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَلى ذلِكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to الشاهدين; the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنَ الشَّاهِدِينَ﴾ the two are attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿وَتَاللَّهِ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿تَاللَّهِ﴾ the tāʾ is a particle of oath; the two are attached to the omitted أقسم. ﴿لَأَكِيدَنَّ﴾ the lām occurs in the response to the oath. ﴿أكيدن﴾ an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, its fāʿil latent; the nūn has no grammatical position. ﴿أَصْنامَكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. [Translator's note: so in the source; the attached pronoun here is the kāf.] ﴿بَعْدَ﴾ an adverb attached to أكيدن. ﴿أَنْ﴾ an accusative-governing particle. ﴿تُوَلُّوا﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿مُدْبِرِينَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial); أن تولوا is, as an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.

daas-irab:58-61.t: ﴿فَجَعَلَهُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction. ﴿جعلهم﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), and the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿جُذاذاً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿كَبِيراً﴾ excepted (mustathnā) by إلا. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ the two (preposition and its genitive noun) are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of كبيرا. ﴿لَعَلَّهُمْ﴾ لعل and its noun. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ the two are attached to يرجعون, and the clause ﴿يَرْجِعُونَ﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of لعل; the clause لعلهم is resumptive. ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مَنْ﴾ an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿فَعَلَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil latent; the clause is the khabar, and the mubtadaʾ and khabar are the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech). ﴿هذا﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بِآلِهَتِنا﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿إِنَّهُ لَمِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ﴾ إن and its noun, and the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). ﴿من الظالمين﴾ the two are attached to the khabar of إن; the clause is resumptive. ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿سَمِعْنا﴾ a past verb and fāʿil; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿فَتًى﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَذْكُرُهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is a naʿt of فتى. ﴿يُقالُ﴾ a passive imperfect verb. ﴿لَهُ﴾ the two are attached to يقال. ﴿إِبْراهِيمُ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَأْتُوا﴾ the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition). ﴿أتوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بِهِ﴾ the two are attached to فأتوا. ﴿عَلى أَعْيُنِ النَّاسِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿النَّاسِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لَعَلَّهُمْ﴾ لعل and its noun. ﴿يَشْهَدُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of لعل, and the clause لعل is resumptive.

daas-irab:62-66.t: ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَأَنْتَ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, and أنت is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿فَعَلْتَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate), and the clause ﴿أَنْتَ فَعَلْتَ﴾ is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech). ﴿هذا﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿بِآلِهَتِنا﴾ the two (preposition and its genitive noun) are attached to (mutaʿalliq) فعلت. ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿إِبْراهِيمُ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), a singular proper noun, in the position of the accusative. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿فَعَلَهُ كَبِيرُهُمْ﴾ a past verb, mafʿūl bihi and postponed fāʿil. ﴿هذا﴾ a naʿt (adjective) of كبيرهم. ﴿فَسْئَلُوهُمْ﴾ the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition). ﴿اسألوهم﴾ an imperative verb, its fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِنْ﴾ conditional. ﴿كانُوا﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the wāw is its noun; the clause ﴿يَنْطِقُونَ﴾ is its khabar, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted. ﴿فَرَجَعُوا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; a past verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿إِلى أَنْفُسِهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to رجعوا. ﴿فَقالُوا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿إِنَّكُمْ﴾ إن and its noun; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿أَنْتُمُ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿الظَّالِمُونَ﴾ khabar; the clause is the khabar of إن. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction denoting delay. ﴿نُكِسُوا﴾ a passive past verb. ﴿والواو﴾ and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is conjoined. ﴿عَلى رُؤُسِهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to نكسوا. ﴿لَقَدْ﴾ the lām occurs in the response to an omitted oath. ﴿قد﴾ a particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿عَلِمْتَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿ما﴾ negating the genus (nāfiya lil-jins). [Translator's note: so in the source; ما here is ordinarily parsed as the Ḥijāzī ما that acts like ليس; "its noun" and "its khabar" below refer to it.] ﴿هؤُلاءِ﴾ the hā is for calling attention (tanbīh). ﴿أولاء﴾ its noun. ﴿يَنْطِقُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is its khabar. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil latent; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿أَفَتَعْبُدُونَ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation and the fāʾ is a conjunction; an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾ the two are attached to تعبدون. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿يَنْفَعُكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, its fāʿil latent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿شَيْئاً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿يَضُرُّكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, its fāʿil latent; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:67-70.t: ﴿أُفٍّ﴾ a verbal noun with imperfect meaning (ism fiʿl muḍāriʿ); the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ the two (preposition and its genitive noun) are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَلِما تَعْبُدُونَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, the lām is a preposition, and ما is relative, in the position of the genitive; the two are conjoined to لكم, and the clause تعبدون is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَفَلا﴾ the hamza is for disapproving interrogation, the fāʾ is a conjunction, and لا is negating. ﴿تَعْقِلُونَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿قالُوا﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿حَرِّقُوهُ﴾ an imperative verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَانْصُرُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿آلِهَتَكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi and the mīm is for the plural. ﴿إِنْ﴾ conditional. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ كان and its noun. ﴿فاعِلِينَ﴾ its khabar (predicate); كنتم is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being حرقوه وانصروا etc. ﴿قُلْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿نارُ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite noun (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of the accusative. ﴿كُونِي بَرْداً﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperative verb, its noun and its khabar. ﴿وَسَلاماً﴾ conjoined to بردا; the clause يا نار.. is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech). ﴿وَأَرادُوا بِهِ كَيْداً﴾ the clause of the verb, the fāʿil and the mafʿūl bihi is conjoined to قالوا, and به: the two are attached to أرادوا. ﴿فَجَعَلْناهُمُ﴾ a past verb, fāʿil and its first object; the clause is conjoined by the fāʾ. ﴿الْأَخْسَرِينَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi.

daas-irab:71-73.t: ﴿وَنَجَّيْناهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to what precedes. ﴿وَلُوطاً﴾ conjoined to the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of نجيناه. ﴿إِلَى الْأَرْضِ﴾ the two (preposition and its genitive noun) are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the preceding verb. ﴿الَّتِي﴾ a relative noun, a naʿt (adjective) in the position of the genitive. ﴿بارَكْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is a ṣila (relative clause) with no grammatical position. ﴿فِيها﴾ the two are attached to باركنا. ﴿لِلْعالَمِينَ﴾ the lām is a preposition, and العالمين is a genitive noun, genitive with the yāʾ because it is treated like the sound masculine plural; the two are attached to باركنا. ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿وَهَبْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes. ﴿لَهُ﴾ the two are attached to the preceding verb. ﴿إِسْحاقَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb). ﴿وَيَعْقُوبَ﴾ conjoined to إسحق. ﴿نافِلَةً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial) from يعقوب. ﴿وَكُلًّا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and كلا is the fronted first mafʿūl bihi of جعلنا. ﴿جَعَلْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿صالِحِينَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is conjoined to what precedes. ﴿وَجَعَلْناهُمْ أَئِمَّةً﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; a past verb, its fāʿil and its two objects; the clause is conjoined to what precedes. ﴿يَهْدُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is a naʿt of أئمة. ﴿بِأَمْرِنا﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿وَأَوْحَيْنا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِلَيْهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to the preceding verb. ﴿فِعْلَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْخَيْراتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَإِقامَ﴾ conjoined to فعل. ﴿الصَّلاةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَإِيتاءَ الزَّكاةِ﴾ conjoined to فعل, and الزكاة is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَكانُوا لَنا عابِدِينَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; كان, its noun and its khabar (predicate); لنا: the two are attached to عابدين.

daas-irab:74-75.t: ﴿وَلُوطاً﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and لوطا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb explained by the one mentioned. ﴿آتَيْناهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its first object; the clause is explicative (mufassira) with no grammatical position. ﴿حُكْماً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi of آتيناه. ﴿وَعِلْماً﴾ conjoined to حكما. ﴿وَنَجَّيْناهُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to what precedes. ﴿مِنَ الْقَرْيَةِ﴾ the two (preposition and its genitive noun) are attached to (mutaʿalliq) نجيناه. ﴿الَّتِي﴾ a relative noun whose position is that of a naʿt (adjective) of القرية. ﴿كانَتْ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, its noun omitted, its implied form being هي. ﴿تَعْمَلُ الْخَبائِثَ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil omitted, and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of كان, and the clause كانت is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. [Translator's note: the source says "omitted" (محذوف) for the noun of كانت and the fāʿil of تعمل; such pronouns are ordinarily called latent (mustatir).] ﴿إِنَّهُمْ﴾ إن and its noun; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya) with no grammatical position. ﴿كانُوا﴾ كان and its noun; the clause is the khabar of إن. ﴿قَوْمَ﴾ khabar of كانوا. ﴿سَوْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فاسِقِينَ﴾ a naʿt, accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ. ﴿وَأَدْخَلْناهُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; a past verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined to what precedes. ﴿فِي رَحْمَتِنا﴾ the two are attached to أدخلناه. ﴿إِنَّهُ مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ﴾ إن and its noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the khabar; the clause إن etc. is causal with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:76-77.t: ﴿وَنُوحاً﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and نوحا is conjoined to لوطا. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿نادى﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the shortened alif owing to impossibility (taʿadhdhur); its fāʿil (agent) is omitted, its implied form being هو; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ the two (preposition and its genitive noun) are attached to (mutaʿalliq) نادى; قبل is an adverb indeclinable on the ḍamma because it is cut off from annexation in wording, not in meaning. ﴿فَاسْتَجَبْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined) by the fāʾ to what precedes. ﴿لَهُ﴾ the two are attached to استجبنا. ﴿فَنَجَّيْناهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is conjoined to what precedes. ﴿وَأَهْلَهُ﴾ conjoined to the object of نجيناه, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنَ الْكَرْبِ﴾ the two are attached to نجيناه. ﴿الْعَظِيمِ﴾ a naʿt (adjective) of الكرب. ﴿وَنَصَرْناهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is conjoined to what precedes. ﴿مِنَ الْقَوْمِ﴾ the two are attached to نصرناه. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of the genitive as a naʿt of القوم. ﴿كَذَّبُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿بِآياتِنا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to كذبوا, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنَّهُمْ﴾ إن and its noun, and the mīm is for the plural; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya) with no grammatical position, and the clause ﴿كانُوا﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of إن. ﴿قَوْمَ﴾ khabar of كانوا. ﴿سَوْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَأَغْرَقْناهُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and the clause أغرقناهم, made up of the verb, the fāʿil and the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), is conjoined by the fāʾ. ﴿أَجْمَعِينَ﴾ tawkīd (emphasis) of the hāʾ in أغرقناهم, accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural.

daas-irab:78-80.t: ﴿وَداوُدَ وَسُلَيْمانَ﴾ conjoined to ونوحا. ﴿إِذْ يَحْكُمانِ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by retention of the nūn, and the alif is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿فِي الْحَرْثِ﴾ the two (preposition and its genitive noun) are attached to (mutaʿalliq) يحكمان. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb attached to the preceding verb. ﴿نَفَشَتْ﴾ a past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿فِيهِ﴾ the two are attached to نفشت. ﴿غَنَمُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿الْقَوْمِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَ﴾ resumptive. ﴿كُنَّا﴾ كان and its noun. ﴿لِحُكْمِهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to شاهدين; the clause is resumptive. ﴿شاهِدِينَ﴾ khabar (predicate), accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿فَفَهَّمْناها سُلَيْمانَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; a past verb, its fāʿil and its two objects; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to what precedes. ﴿وَكُلًّا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and [كلا is the] first mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of آتينا. ﴿آتَيْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿حُكْماً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi of آتينا. ﴿وَعِلْماً﴾ conjoined to حكما; the clause is conjoined to what precedes. ﴿وَسَخَّرْنا﴾ the wāw is resumptive; a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مَعَ﴾ an adverb attached to سخرنا. ﴿داوُدَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, a diptote. ﴿الْجِبالَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi of سخرنا. ﴿يُسَبِّحْنَ﴾ an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn because it is joined to the nūn of the feminine plural, and the nūn is the fāʿil; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from الجبال. ﴿وَالطَّيْرَ﴾ conjoined to الجبال, or a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment). ﴿وَكُنَّا﴾ كان and its noun. ﴿فاعِلِينَ﴾ khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَعَلَّمْناهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its first object; the clause is conjoined. ﴿صَنْعَةَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لَبُوسٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of لبوس. ﴿لِتُحْصِنَكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) أن after the lām of causation (taʿlīl), its fāʿil latent (mustatir), and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi; أن and what follows it are, as an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), in the position of the genitive, [and with the lām] the two are attached to علمناه. ﴿مِنْ بَأْسِكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to the verb before them. ﴿فَهَلْ أَنْتُمْ شاكِرُونَ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, هل is an interrogative particle, أنتم is mubtadaʾ (subject) and شاكرون is khabar; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:81-82.t: ﴿وَلِسُلَيْمانَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being سخرنا. ﴿الرِّيحَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the omitted verb. ﴿عاصِفَةً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial) from الريح. ﴿تَجْرِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ owing to heaviness, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir); the clause is a second ḥāl. ﴿بِأَمْرِهِ﴾ the two are attached to the verb before them. ﴿إِلى الْأَرْضِ﴾ the two are attached to the verb before them. ﴿الَّتِي﴾ a relative noun whose position is the genitive, as a naʿt (adjective). ﴿بارَكْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is a ṣila (relative clause) with no grammatical position. ﴿فِيها﴾ the two are attached to the verb before them. ﴿وَكُنَّا﴾ كان and its noun; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿بِكُلِّ﴾ the two are attached to the khabar (predicate) after them. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عالِمِينَ﴾ khabar, accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿وَمِنَ الشَّياطِينِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being وسخرنا. ﴿مِنَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi of the omitted verb سخرنا; or it is in the position of the nominative as a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), and من الشياطين is attached to a fronted khabar; the clause is conjoined to what precedes. [Translator's note: the parsed word is the relative noun ﴿مَنْ﴾ of the verse; the source vocalises it مِنَ.] ﴿يَغُوصُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is a ṣila with no grammatical position. ﴿لَهُ﴾ the two are attached to the preceding verb. ﴿وَيَعْمَلُونَ عَمَلًا﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the clause is conjoined. ﴿دُونَ﴾ an adverb attached to a naʿt of عملا. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ ذا is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿وَكُنَّا﴾ كان and its noun. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ the two are attached to حافظين. ﴿حافِظِينَ﴾ the khabar of كنا, accusative with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:83-85.t: ﴿وَأَيُّوبَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and أيوب is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being اذكر. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted verb اذكر. ﴿نادى﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif owing to impossibility (taʿadhdhur), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause نادى is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿رَبَّهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi of نادى, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَنِّي﴾ أن and its noun. ﴿مَسَّنِيَ﴾ a past verb; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ is a fronted mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الضُّرُّ﴾ postponed fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of أن. ﴿وَأَنْتَ أَرْحَمُ﴾ the wāw is the wāw of ḥāl, [then] mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar; the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿الرَّاحِمِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَاسْتَجَبْنا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and استجبنا is a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to what precedes. ﴿لَهُ﴾ the two (preposition and its genitive noun) are attached to استجبنا. ﴿فَكَشَفْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿ما﴾ relative, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بِهِ﴾ the two are attached to the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَآتَيْناهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its first object; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَهْلَهُ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَمِثْلَهُمْ﴾ conjoined to أهله. ﴿مَعَهُمْ﴾ an adverb of place attached to an omitted ḥāl, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿رَحْمَةً﴾ mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿مِنْ عِنْدِنا﴾ the two are attached to a naʿt (adjective) of رحمة. ﴿وَذِكْرى﴾ conjoined to رحمة. ﴿لِلْعابِدِينَ﴾ the two are attached to ذكرى. ﴿وَإِسْماعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَذَا الْكِفْلِ﴾ conjoined to the prophets already mentioned. ﴿وَإِسْماعِيلَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, its implied form being اذكر. ﴿كُلٌّ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿مِنَ الصَّابِرِينَ﴾ the two are attached to the omitted khabar; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:86-88.t: ﴿وَأَدْخَلْناهُمْ﴾ a past verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to what precedes. ﴿فِي رَحْمَتِنا﴾ the two (preposition and its genitive noun) are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿إِنَّهُمْ﴾ إن and its noun. ﴿مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ﴾ the two are attached to the khabar (predicate) of إن; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya) with no grammatical position. ﴿وَذَا النُّونِ﴾ conjoined to the prophets already mentioned, or ذا is the mafʿūl bihi of the verb اذكر, accusative (manṣūb) with the alif because it is one of the five nouns; النون, meaning "the whale", is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb of time attached to the implied (muqaddar) verb اذكر. ﴿ذَهَبَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir); the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مُغاضِباً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, from the latent fāʿil. ﴿فَظَنَّ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; a past verb, its fāʿil latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَنْ﴾ lightened from the heavy أنّ, its noun being the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn). ﴿لَنْ﴾ a particle of negation, accusative government and futurity. ﴿نَقْدِرَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by لن, its fāʿil latent. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ the two are attached to نقدر; أن and what follows it fill the place of the two objects of ظن. ﴿فَنادى﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied fatḥa on the alif, its fāʿil latent, its implied form being هو; the clause is conjoined by the fāʾ to what precedes. ﴿فِي الظُّلُماتِ﴾ the two are attached to نادى. ﴿أَنْ﴾ a particle resembling the verb, lightened from the heavy أنّ, its noun being the pronoun of the matter, its implied form being أنه. ﴿لا﴾ the lā of generic negation. ﴿إِلهَ﴾ its noun. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿الله﴾ the Name of Majesty, badal (substitute); the clause is the khabar of أن. ﴿سُبْحانَكَ﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being أسبح, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause reinforces the preceding clause. ﴿إِنِّي﴾ إن and its noun. ﴿كُنْتُ﴾ كان and its noun. ﴿مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ﴾ the two are attached to the khabar of كنت; the clause is the khabar of إني, and the clause إني is causal with no grammatical position. ﴿فَاسْتَجَبْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿لَهُ﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿وَنَجَّيْناهُ﴾ the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنَ الْغَمِّ﴾ the two are attached to نجيناه. ﴿وَكَذلِكَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, the kāf is a preposition and ذا is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive; the two are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of a mafʿūl muṭlaq; the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿نُنْجِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied ḍamma on the yāʾ owing to heaviness, its fāʿil latent. ﴿الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:89-91.t: ﴿وَزَكَرِيَّا﴾ conjoined to what precedes, or the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the omitted verb اذكر. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿نادى﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir); the clause is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿رَبَّهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿رَبِّ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), accusative (manṣūb), the vocative particle having been omitted; the sign of its accusative is an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, which was deleted for lightness, and the deleted yāʾ of the speaker is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لا﴾ prohibitive, used for supplication. ﴿تَذَرْنِي﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm); the nūn is for protection (wiqāya) and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَرْداً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative; the preceding clauses are in the position of the accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech) of the omitted verb قال, its implied form being قال رب etc. ﴿وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), [then] mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿الْوارِثِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿فَاسْتَجَبْنا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive; a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَهُ﴾ the two (preposition and its genitive noun) are attached to (mutaʿalliq) استجبنا. ﴿وَوَهَبْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿لَهُ﴾ the two are attached to وهبنا. ﴿يَحْيى﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative with an implied fatḥa on the alif; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined) by the wāw, and likewise ﴿وَأَصْلَحْنا لَهُ زَوْجَهُ﴾. ﴿إِنَّهُمْ﴾ إن and its noun; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya) with no grammatical position. ﴿كانُوا﴾ كان and its noun; the clause is the khabar of إن. ﴿يُسارِعُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of كان. ﴿فِي الْخَيْراتِ﴾ the two are attached to يسارعون. ﴿وَيَدْعُونَنا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; an imperfect verb, nominative by retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil and نا is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿رَغَباً وَرَهَباً﴾ two ḥāls, or two mafʿūls li-ajlihi (objects of purpose). ﴿وَكانُوا﴾ كان and its noun. ﴿لَنا﴾ the two are attached to the postponed khabar. ﴿خاشِعِينَ﴾ khabar, accusative with the yāʾ; the clause is conjoined to what precedes. ﴿وَالَّتِي﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿الَّتِي﴾ a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi of the omitted verb اذكر; the clause is conjoined to what precedes. ﴿أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَها﴾ a past verb, the tāʾ being for the feminine, its fāʿil latent, and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is a ṣila (relative clause) with no grammatical position. ﴿فَنَفَخْنا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فِيها﴾ the two are attached to نفخنا. ﴿مِنْ رُوحِنا﴾ the two are attached to نفخنا, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَجَعَلْناها﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its first object. ﴿وَابْنَها﴾ conjoined to the hāʾ in جعلناها, or a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment). ﴿آيَةً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لِلْعالَمِينَ﴾ the lām is a preposition, and العالمين is a genitive noun, genitive with the yāʾ because it is treated like the sound masculine plural; the clause is conjoined to what precedes.

daas-irab:92-95.t: ﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿هذِهِ﴾ the hāʾ is for calling attention (tanbīh), and ذا is a demonstrative in the position of the accusative as the noun of إن. ﴿أُمَّتُكُمْ﴾ khabar (predicate), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿أُمَّةً﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial), or a badal (substitute) from هذه. ﴿واحِدَةً﴾ a naʿt (adjective). ﴿وَأَنَا رَبُّكُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined) by the wāw. ﴿فَاعْبُدُونِ﴾ the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition); اعبدون is an imperative verb, the wāw is its fāʿil (agent), and the yāʾ of the speaker, deleted following the orthography of the Muṣḥaf, is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿وَتَقَطَّعُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَمْرَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, in the sense of "they split up their affair". ﴿بَيْنَهُمْ﴾ an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb تقطعوا, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿كُلٌّ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿إِلَيْنا﴾ the two (preposition and its genitive noun) are attached to راجعون. ﴿راجِعُونَ﴾ khabar, nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is a ḥāl or resumptive. ﴿فَمَنْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive; من is a jussive-governing conditional noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَعْمَلْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm); it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿مِنَ الصَّالِحاتِ﴾ the two are attached to يعمل. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); هو is mubtadaʾ. ﴿مُؤْمِنٌ﴾ khabar; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis, and لا is negating, operating like إنّ. ﴿كُفْرانَ﴾ its noun. ﴿لِسَعْيِهِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted khabar of لا. ﴿وَإِنَّا لَهُ كاتِبُونَ﴾ إن, its noun and its khabar, and له: the two are attached to the khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَحَرامٌ﴾ fronted khabar. ﴿عَلى قَرْيَةٍ﴾ the two are attached to حرام. ﴿أَهْلَكْناها﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is a naʿt of قرية. ﴿أَنَّهُمْ لا يَرْجِعُونَ﴾ أن, and the hāʾ is its noun; لا is negating, and يرجعون is an imperfect verb, the wāw being its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of أن, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from أنّ and what follows it is the postponed mubtadaʾ.

daas-irab:96-97.t: ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit (ghāya) taking the genitive. ﴿إِذا﴾ an adverb for future time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted [verb], its implied form being قالوا يا ويلنا. ﴿فُتِحَتْ﴾ a passive past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿يَأْجُوجُ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿وَمَأْجُوجُ﴾ conjoined to it; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is the wāw of ḥāl, and هم is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مِنْ كُلِّ﴾ the two (preposition and its genitive noun) are attached to ينسلون. ﴿حَدَبٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يَنْسِلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is the khabar (predicate), and the clause هم etc. is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَاقْتَرَبَ الْوَعْدُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; a past verb and fāʿil; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to what precedes. ﴿الْحَقُّ﴾ a naʿt (adjective) of الوعد. ﴿فَإِذا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and إذا is the one of surprise (fujāʾiyya); it enters upon the nominal clause and has no grammatical position. ﴿هِيَ شاخِصَةٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is conjoined to what precedes. ﴿أَبْصارُ﴾ fāʿil of شاخصة. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿يا﴾ vocative. ﴿وَيْلَنا﴾ the one addressed (munādā), in a genitive construct (muḍāf), and نا is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech) of an omitted verb, its implied form being قالوا يا ويلنا. ﴿قَدْ﴾ a particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿كُنَّا﴾ كان and its noun. ﴿فِي غَفْلَةٍ﴾ the two are attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a preposition. ﴿هذا﴾ the hā is for calling attention (tanbīh), and ذا is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive; the two are attached to غفلة. ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿كُنَّا﴾ كان and its noun. ﴿ظالِمِينَ﴾ khabar of كان, accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is the omitted maqūl al-qawl.

daas-irab:98-101.t: ﴿إِنَّكُمْ﴾ إن and its noun, and the mīm is for the plural. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and ما is relative, conjoined to the kāf. ﴿تَعْبُدُونَ﴾ the clause is a ṣila (relative clause) with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾ the two (preposition and its genitive noun) are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ omitted in تعبدونه. ﴿حَصَبُ﴾ khabar (predicate) of إن, and its clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿جَهَنَّمَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) with the fatḥa because it is a diptote. ﴿أَنْتُمْ﴾ a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لَها﴾ the two are attached to the postponed khabar. ﴿وارِدُونَ﴾ khabar of the mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَوْ﴾ a conditional particle, not jussive-governing. ﴿كانَ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿هؤُلاءِ﴾ the hā is for calling attention (tanbīh), and أولاء is a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the kasra, in the position of the nominative as the noun of كان. ﴿آلِهَةً﴾ khabar; the clause is initial with no grammatical position. ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿وَرَدُوها﴾ a past verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿وَكُلٌّ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِيها﴾ the two are attached to the postponed khabar. ﴿خالِدُونَ﴾ khabar, nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ the two are attached to a fronted khabar. ﴿فِيها﴾ the two are attached to the fronted khabar. ﴿زَفِيرٌ﴾ postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; هم is a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِيها﴾ the two are attached to يسمعون. ﴿لا يَسْمَعُونَ﴾ لا is negating, and يسمعون is an imperfect verb, nominative by retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar. ﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, the noun of إن. ﴿سَبَقَتْ﴾ a past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ and ﴿مِنَّا﴾ both are attached to the verb. ﴿الْحُسْنى﴾ fāʿil, nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif owing to impossibility (taʿadhdhur). ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ the demonstrative is mubtadaʾ; the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿عَنْها﴾ the two are attached to مبعدون. ﴿مُبْعَدُونَ﴾ khabar, nominative with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of إن.

daas-irab:102-104.t: ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿يَسْمَعُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿حَسِيسَها﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and ها is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); the clause is a second khabar (predicate) of إن, or in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the latent (mustatir) pronoun in مبعدون. ﴿وَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) and هم is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿فِي﴾ a preposition. ﴿مَا﴾ relative; the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb after them. [Translator's note: so in the source; the verb after them is the ṣila, and the attachment is presumably to خالدون.] ﴿اشْتَهَتْ﴾ a past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿أَنْفُسُهُمْ﴾ fāʿil, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) and the mīm is for the plural; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿خالِدُونَ﴾ khabar, nominative with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿لا يَحْزُنُهُمُ﴾ لا is negating; an imperfect verb and its object, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. [Translator's note: so in the source; the hāʾ here is the verb's object, as the source itself has just said.] ﴿الْفَزَعُ﴾ postponed fāʿil. ﴿الْأَكْبَرُ﴾ a naʿt (adjective) of الفزع; the clause is a badal (substitute) from the preceding clause, or in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿وَتَتَلَقَّاهُمُ الْمَلائِكَةُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif owing to impossibility (taʿadhdhur); the hāʾ is its fronted object and الملائكة its postponed fāʿil; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to what precedes. ﴿هذا يَوْمُكُمُ﴾ mubtadaʾ and khabar, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is in the position of the accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech) of the omitted verb يقولون. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative noun, a naʿt of يوم, in the position of the nominative. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ كان and its noun; the clause is a ṣila with no grammatical position. ﴿تُوعَدُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, nominative by retention of the nūn, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the khabar of كنتم. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time attached to the omitted verb اذكر. ﴿نَطْوِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied ḍamma on the yāʾ owing to heaviness, its fāʿil latent; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿السَّماءَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿كَطَيِّ﴾ the two (preposition and its genitive noun) are attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), the implied form being طيا. ﴿السِّجِلِّ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لِلْكُتُبِ﴾ the two are attached to the maṣdar (verbal noun). ﴿كَما﴾ the kāf is a preposition. ﴿ما﴾ relative or maṣdariyya. ﴿بَدَأْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿أَوَّلَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿خَلْقٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿نُعِيدُهُ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, its fāʿil latent. ﴿وَعْداً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq of an omitted verb. ﴿عَلَيْنا﴾ the two are attached to وعدا. ﴿إِنَّا﴾ إن and its noun. ﴿كُنَّا﴾ كان and its noun; the clause كنا etc. is the khabar of إن, and إن with its noun and khabar is a resumptive clause. ﴿فاعِلِينَ﴾ the khabar of كان, accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural.

daas-irab:105-108.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, the lām occurs in the response to an omitted oath, and قد is a particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿كَتَبْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿فِي الزَّبُورِ﴾ the two (preposition and its genitive noun) are attached to (mutaʿalliq) كتبنا; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the response to an oath. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾ the two are attached to the preceding verb. ﴿الذِّكْرِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَنَّ الْأَرْضَ﴾ أن and its noun; its clause is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿يَرِثُها﴾ an imperfect verb and its object. ﴿عِبادِيَ﴾ fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of أن. ﴿الصَّالِحُونَ﴾ a naʿt (adjective), nominative with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿فِي هذا﴾ ذا is a demonstrative; the two are attached to the omitted fronted khabar of إن. ﴿لَبَلاغاً﴾ the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and بلاغا is the postponed noun of إن. ﴿لِقَوْمٍ﴾ the two are attached to بلاغا. ﴿عابِدِينَ﴾ a naʿt of قوم, genitive (majrūr) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive and ما is negating. ﴿أَرْسَلْناكَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿رَحْمَةً﴾ mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿لِلْعالَمِينَ﴾ the two are attached to رحمة. ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّما﴾ the restraining [mā] and the restrained [inna] (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿يُوحى﴾ a passive imperfect verb, nominative with an implied ḍamma on the alif owing to impossibility (taʿadhdhur); the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech). ﴿إِلَيَّ﴾ the two are attached to يوحى. ﴿إِنَّما﴾ the restraining and the restrained. ﴿إِلهُكُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلهٌ﴾ khabar. ﴿واحِدٌ﴾ a naʿt of إله; the clause أنما إلهكم إله is, as an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), in the position of the nominative as the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of يوحى. [Translator's note: the source heads this word ﴿إِنَّما﴾, but the verse reads ﴿أَنَّما﴾, as its own analysis (أنما … in the position of nāʾib fāʿil) assumes.] ﴿فَهَلْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive; هل is an interrogative particle. ﴿أَنْتُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ﴾ mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:109-112.t: ﴿فَإِنْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive; إن is a jussive-governing conditional particle. ﴿تَوَلَّوْا﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif, which was deleted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿فَقُلْ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis, and قل is an imperative verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir); the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿آذَنْتُكُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech). ﴿عَلى سَواءٍ﴾ the two (preposition and its genitive noun) are attached to (mutaʿalliq) آذنتكم. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive or circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and إن is a particle of negation. ﴿أَدْرِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied ḍamma on the yāʾ owing to heaviness, its fāʿil latent; the clause is resumptive or a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿أَقَرِيبٌ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation. ﴿قَرِيبٌ﴾ fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿أَمْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿بَعِيدٌ﴾ conjoined to قريب. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun in the position of the nominative as postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is the maqūl al-qawl of أدري. [Translator's note: so in the source; the clause is ordinarily described as the object of أدري, whose operation is suspended.] ﴿تُوعَدُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is a ṣila (relative clause) with no grammatical position. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ إن and its noun. ﴿يَعْلَمُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent. ﴿الْجَهْرَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the khabar. ﴿مِنَ الْقَوْلِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl from الجهر. ﴿وَيَعْلَمُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; an imperfect verb, nominative, its fāʿil latent; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿تَكْتُمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive and إن is negating. ﴿أَدْرِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied ḍamma on the yāʾ owing to heaviness, and its fāʿil is latent. ﴿لَعَلَّهُ فِتْنَةٌ﴾ لعل, its noun and its khabar. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to فتنة or to a naʿt (adjective) of it. ﴿وَمَتاعٌ﴾ conjoined to فتنة. ﴿إِلى حِينٍ﴾ the two are attached to متاع; the clause is in the position of the accusative as the mafʿūl bihi of أدري. ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿رَبِّ﴾ the one addressed (munādā) with an omitted vocative particle; it is annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the speaker; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿احْكُمْ﴾ a verb of supplication, its fāʿil omitted. ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾ the two are attached to احكم. ﴿وَرَبُّنَا الرَّحْمنُ الْمُسْتَعانُ﴾ mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿عَلى ما﴾ ما is a relative noun in the position of the genitive by على, and the two are attached to المستعان. ﴿تَصِفُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila.
